automation_parts: Guard-door handle for the robot (Ø12 x 130 bar on two Ø10 standoffs, 6061)

Door drive: pneumatic rotary actuator on the hinge axis, SMC CRQ2 size 20 class (~1.8 N m at 0.5 MPa, stroke set to 95 deg, meter-out flow controls; envelope 47 x 47 x 42 mm). Passive alternative: McMaster 6597K124 one-way damper, same envelope
Door drive bracket (6061, 4 mm, flanged onto the chamber's left side face)
Door drive shaft and disc (Ø6 D-shaft keyed into a 6061 disc screwed to the door's left edge)
Draw-latch actuators: 2 x Ø20 compact air cylinders (SMC CJ2/CQ2 class, 157 N at 0.5 MPa) that throw the latch levers
Drawer latch wing head, left (26 mm wing on the quarter-turn stud: the robot turns it 90 deg)
Drawer latch wing head, right (26 mm wing on the quarter-turn stud: the robot turns it 90 deg)
Blade-cartridge grip fin (6061, 4 mm, on the holder's front end)
Liner pull tabs (316L, 2 mm, 12 mm off each side liner, spot-welded)
AprilTag plates (2 x tag36h11, 56 mm, on the guard's front-left post: wrist-camera re-registration)
